elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires HDI, at the Company's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(a) provides assistance for up to six months following the Termination Date.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(a) expressly specifies HDI's then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires HDI to return to the Company all Company Content, user information, and customer data in HDI's possession or control.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires return within 30 days of the Termination Date, under a provision expressly triggered by expiration or termination.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) expressly requires a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor deletes that data from its systems.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(c) requires HDI thereafter to delete all returned categories of data from its systems.

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor certifies deletion of the Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(c) requires HDI to certify the deletion in writing to the Company.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires HDI, at the Company's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The assistance period is up to six months at the Company's request, which permits the Company to obtain 90 days of assistance.

elements.element: Vendor exports or returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires HDI to return Company Content, user information, and customer data to the Company.

elements.element: Vendor exports or returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires return within 30 days of the Termination Date, and the provision is triggered by either expiration or termination.

result.reason: The inserted operative provision satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It adds only transition, return, deletion, and certification terms relevant to the rule and leaves the existing termination-payment provision unchanged. Drafting is strong, although using the defined term “Termination Date” for a clause also triggered by expiration could create minor ambiguity if that term does not encompass expiry.
